problem_statement: Running multiple separate filter().count() calls over 24.6M rows takes several minutes due to repeated Spark stages and Py4J socket overhead.
solution_or_decision: Consolidate all null, range, step, zero, and duplicate checks into a single .agg(...) pass using count(when(...)).
evidence: Audit duration reduced from over 5 minutes to 63.47 seconds on 24,675,013 rows with 12 cores.
root_cause: Each count() triggers an independent Spark job and shuffle barrier over the entire dataset.
